records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our software and products revenue was 47% and 45% of our total revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2022 and 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended June 30, 2022 and 2021, approximately 81% and 60% of software license revenue was sold under a subscription model, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Larger deal transactions (transactions greater than $0.1 million of software and products revenue) represented 75% and 69% of our total software and products revenue in the three months ended June 30, 2022 and 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To the extent the U.S. dollar weakens against foreign currencies, the translation of these foreign currency denominated transactions generally results in increased revenue, operating expenses and income from operations for our non-U.S. operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: –Net cash provided by operating activities was impacted by net income adjusted for the impact of non-cash charges and a decrease in accrued liabilities partially offset by a decrease in accounts receivable.
